full_text:
Unnamed Suit 003 is a Suit working for the Organization, previously commanded by DeFoe. She is one of the agents stationed in Venice, Italy.

== History ==
She was sent by DeFoe to assist in the retrieval of Eathon Lambert's journal. Along with another Suit and their Mindrone Titans, she attempted to capture Sophie Casterwill. This Suit, however, was defeated by Sophie and Santiago. [A Seeker Is Born]

She was one of the many Suits called in by DeFoe to stop Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, and Sophie Casterwill in the Venice Huntik Library. This Suit, along with the others, was defeated by Dante's team and Santiago. [The Casterwill Client]

== Abilities ==
Like most Suits, she was issued with the standard Organization Titans and spells.

=== Spells Utilized ===
* Hyperstride

=== Bonded Titans ===
* Mindrone
